title: How to Create New Membership Plans - Add Free or Paid Membership Plans | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Create New Membership Plans - Add Free or Paid Membership Plans Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046487 This article explains how to set up free membership plans. With a free membership plan, members do not need to pay to join the website.The same process applies to paid membership plans by configuring a sign-up price. To set this up, follow the steps below: 1. Navigate to the admin and click Finance » Membership Plans. Find the membership plan that needs to be set as "Free" and click Edit: 2. Then go to the "Sign Ups & Upgrades" tab and make sure that the "Account Type" is Free . When 'Free' is selected, the pricing options will be hidden. The only pricing option that remains visible is Price to Purchase Leads Usually, free members need to pay for leads and any other paid posts or services offered by the admin. 3. Also in the Sign Ups & Upgrades tab, make sure to select "Sign Up Email Sent" --> "Welcome-basic" and also make sure the "After Sign Up, Set Account Status As:" is set to "Inactive Account, Requires Email Verification". This way, members must verify their email addresses before their accounts become active 4. When everything has been set up, create a test member. To do this, scroll up and click the "Sign Up Page" button: The 'Select a Payment Option' section will no longer appear and the system will display this form where members can add their email and password. Additional documentation for setting up recurring payments is available here: Setting up Recurring Payments To create one-time subscriptions, read this article: Setting up One Time Payments To edit the amounts displayed on the /join page, read these articles: Side-By-Side Pricing Plans: How To Link Membership Plans To The Price Matrix Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page) For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
